transcript: The number one secret to losing weight faster is simple. Stop chasing diets. It's discipline and removing what's blocking your body. Your body already knows how to change. You just need to stop interfering with it. Start by walking 10 minutes after every meal. It helps digestion and teaches your body to burn instead of store. Eat within an eight-hour window and let your system rest the rest of the day. For seven days, remove sugar, fried foods and late night snacking. Drink clean water instead of liquid calories. Keep your food simple and real. Rice, vegetables, eggs, fruit, soups and lean protein. When you stop confusing your body, it starts responding. In seven days, you may notice the first change. In 14 days, you may feel lighter, clearer and more in control. If this helped you, follow this page and share this with someone who needs it. And if you want deeper guidance, my e-book is linked in my profile.
